privacy_policy_intro: This Privacy Policy describes the policies and procedures of the 'Reminder' application ("the App") on the collection, use, and disclosure of your information.
privacy_policy_info_collection_body: The App is designed as a simple, privacy-first tool for managing time-based notifications. We believe that your data belongs to you, and our App is built to reflect that commitment.
privacy_policy_no_personal_data_body:
The App DOES NOT require you to create an account, register, or provide any personal information to use its features. We do not collect, store, or have access to:

• Your email address, or phone number.
• Your contacts or calendar information.
• Any other personally identifiable information (PII).
privacy_policy_no_location_data_body: The App DOES NOT access, collect, or share your location data. We do not use your device's GPS or network-based location services.
privacy_policy_local_storage_body: All reminder data, titles, descriptions, and notification schedules you create are stored locally on your device. This information is never uploaded to any external servers, cloud services, or shared with third parties.
privacy_policy_notifications_body: The App requires permission to send you local notifications to alert you of your set reminders. These notifications are triggered by your device's internal system clock and do not involve any external communication or tracking.
privacy_policy_data_safety_intro: For the purposes of the Google Play Data Safety section:
privacy_policy_data_encrypted: Data Encrypted in Transit: As the App does not transmit data to any external servers, no user data is sent over the network. Should any future updates involve data transmission, it will be encrypted using secure industry-standard protocols (e.g., HTTPS).
privacy_policy_data_deletion:
Data Deletion: Since all your data is stored locally, you can delete all information created within the App at any time by:
• Clearing the App's storage/cache in your device settings.
• Uninstalling the App.
privacy_policy_data_sharing: Data Sharing: We do not share any data with third parties or service providers.
privacy_policy_changes_body: We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy within the App or on our hosting platform. You are advised to review this Privacy Policy periodically for any changes.
privacy_policy_contact_body: If you have any questions or suggestions about our Privacy Policy, do not hesitate to contact us at:
welcome_notification_body: Ready to stay organized? Set a quick reminder so you never miss what matters most.
